_note: Source of truth for the Codex coding-agent /model and /effort pickers. Hand-maintained like cc_menu_options.json — the Codex CLI's `exec --json` stream does not expose available models programmatically (https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/14736). Current lineup per https://developers.openai.com/codex/models (checked 2026-06-12). include_str!() baked at compile time, parsed once via LazyLock — no runtime IO cost.
